title: PVAutonomy firmware-defs manifest
description: Validation schema for the firmware-definition bundle manifest (the single versioned unit P2 pins and bundles into the integration release, and which sources the ADR-0001 C3 manifest 'defs version'). The manifest file itself (defs-manifest.json) is introduced in ADR-0001 P1-b; this schema is authored ahead of it in P1-a. DATA only; the generator stays integration code (ADR-0001 D3).

defs_version.description: Single semver for the whole firmware-defs bundle (base + registry + schema). The C3-traceable 'defs version'.

schema_version.description: Version of the inverter-registry schema the bundled registry data validates against.

base_version.description: Version/identifier of the bundled ESPHome base templates.

esphome_min_version.description: Minimum ESPHome version the bundled base requires (D-ADDON-BASELINE-SEC-001, e.g. "2025.12.0").

generated.description: ISO-8601 date/time the manifest was produced (stamped by the release process).

source.description: Provenance pointer (repo + ref) the bundle was pinned from.
